description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single summon attacks (3.05 each) capped at 19999, grants [MAG and MND +50% (25s)], [Damage Cap +10000], [Attach Ice with Stacking], [Ice Resonance +5% Boost], and [Dual Awoken Ice Mode I (Ysayle II)]

description.name: Dual Awoken Ice Mode I (Ysayle II)
description.text: Ice abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Ice abilities trigger 2 additional times, cast speed x2.00 for equipped Ice abilities

description.name: Dual Shift

description.name: Dual Umbral Freeze
description.text: Grants [Damage Cap +20000 1] and [Ice +50% Boost 1], Summoning Smart Ether 2 to the user

description.name: Attach Ice with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Ice Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Ice 3
